Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human TYK2 (CHEMBL3553) in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3553 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
